def quarter(month):
    """Return the quarter number (1-4) for a calendar month (1-12)."""
    if not isinstance(month, int) or isinstance(month, bool) or not 1 <= month <= 12:
        raise ValueError("month must be an integer from 1 to 12")
    return (month - 1) // 3 + 1
